seo.title: Tennis Buddy: find a hitting partner in Figueira da Foz
seo.description: Post the times you can play, see who is free at the same time and a similar NTRP level, and arrange the match in chat. Launching in Figueira da Foz.

steps.title: How it works
steps.description: Four steps from a free evening to a booked court.

add.title: Add when you can play
add.description: Concrete slots in 30-minute steps on a month calendar, with a venue if you have one. Regulars copy last week in one tap.

find.title: Find a game
find.description: See who is free in the next 7 days. Filter by time of day, level, format and venue. Results are grouped by day.

ask.title: Ask to play
ask.description: Send a request on a slot with an optional note. The other player accepts or declines, and you hear back in the app and by email.

chat.title: Chat and meet
chat.description: Accepting opens a private chat with the matched slot pinned at the top. Agree on the court and go.

steps.requestNote: Court 3 is usually free at 6. I'll book it, bring balls?
steps.chatTheirs: Boa! See you at the club.
steps.chatMine: Running 5 min late, warm up without me.

levels.title: Say your level in NTRP
levels.description: Self-declared, from 1.0 to 7.0 in half steps. Search starts half a point either side of yours, so the players you see can actually give you a game.

items.ntrp25: Learning to rally. Court coverage is still a work in progress.
items.ntrp30: Fairly consistent on medium-paced shots, not yet on every stroke.
items.ntrp35: Dependable strokes with directional control, starting to use spin and depth.
items.ntrp40: Reliable on both sides, can vary pace and hit with depth.
items.ntrp45: Uses power and spin, handles pace, closes points at the net.
items.ntrp50: Anticipates well, has a weapon and builds points around it.

safety.title: Built to be safe from day one
safety.description: Only what is needed to arrange a match, and clear ways to walk away from anyone you would rather not play with.

verified.title: Verified accounts
verified.description: Email addresses are confirmed before the first sign-in. Google and Facebook sign-in count as verified.

noPhone.title: No phone numbers
noPhone.description: Chat stays in the app. Numbers are never stored or shown, so you decide what to share and when.

block.title: Block and report
block.description: Blocking hides you both ways and cancels any open request between you. Reports are read by a person.

adults.title: 18 and over
adults.description: Checked from your birth date when you set up your profile.

cta.title: Figueira da Foz first.
cta.description: The app is being built now. Create an account, add the times you can play, and players near you can find you the day it opens. More cities come after.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Welcome back. Sign in to see who is free to play.

fields.displayNamePlaceholder: What people call you on court

fields.languages: Languages you can arrange a game in
fields.bioPlaceholder: How you play, when you are usually free, what you look for in a partner.

ntrpLevels.ntrp10: You are just starting to play tennis.
ntrpLevels.ntrp15: You have limited experience and are still mostly working on getting the ball into play.
ntrpLevels.ntrp20: You need court time: your strokes have obvious weaknesses, but you know the basic positions for singles and doubles.
ntrpLevels.ntrp25: You are learning to judge where the ball is going and can sustain a short, slow rally with players of your level, though your court coverage is still weak.
ntrpLevels.ntrp30: You are fairly consistent on medium-paced balls but not yet comfortable with every stroke, and direction, depth and power are still hard to control.
ntrpLevels.ntrp35: Your strokes are dependable with directional control on moderate balls, but still lack depth and variety; you are starting to come to the net more.
ntrpLevels.ntrp40: You have dependable strokes on both sides with direction and depth, and use lobs, overheads, approach shots and volleys with some success.
ntrpLevels.ntrp45: You are starting to master power and spin, handle pace, control depth and adapt your game plan to the opponent; your first serve has power and accuracy.
ntrpLevels.ntrp50: You anticipate well and have an outstanding shot to build your game around; you finish points off short balls and volleys and can execute lobs, drop shots and half volleys.
ntrpLevels.ntrp55: Power or consistency is your main weapon; you vary strategy and style in competition and hit dependable shots under pressure.
ntrpLevels.ntrp60: You have had intensive training for national competition at junior or college level and have held a sectional or national ranking.
ntrpLevels.ntrp65: You have extensive experience in satellite-level or equivalent international tournaments.
ntrpLevels.ntrp70: A world-class player committed to international tournament competition, earning a living from prize money.
